sentences.en: An offering of flowers had been placed at the grave.
sentences.zh: 有人在墓碑前献上了鲜花。

sentences.en: Happy are they that go to bed with grave music.
sentences.zh: 听着庄严的音乐入睡的人是幸福的。

sentences.en: They are sitting around the graves of their dead ancestors.
sentences.zh: 他们围坐在已故祖先的坟墓旁。

senses.zh: 墓穴，坟墓；死亡；沉音符；（废旧机器等的）堆积处
